facts.fact: The Herald reports the Impilo EHR, piloted in rural health centres, has been extended to major hospitals such as Chitungwiza Central and United Bulawayo Hospitals.
The ministry's informatics director says Impilo is deployed in 1,254 public health institutions, hospitals included, about 60% fully operational and the rest in transition.
Impilo is a home-grown platform run by the Ministry of Health and Child Care, whose director of informatics says it owns the software without licensing requirements.
The ministry says the Impilo rollout is part of a broader digital health strategy, with all institutions targeted by 31 December 2025.
Deployment reached 1,254 institutions by August 2025 and is under way at Parirenyatwa hospitals and the Sally Mugabe Central Hospital paediatric unit.
